name: pmkusumgrid_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for PM-KUSUM grid power authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: pmkusumgrid_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check eligibility. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: pmkusumgrid_check_eligibility
description: Checks farmer's eligibility for grid-connected solar plant based on land ownership, grid connectivity, and capacity limits. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if grid not available, land insufficient, or farmer already has a solar plant under the scheme.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_apply_system
description: Submits application for a grid-connected solar plant. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Requires session_token. Farmer must be eligible. Does NOT approve or install. Fails if ineligible, duplicate, or capacity exceeds limits.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_track_application_status
description: Returns application_status ('not_applied', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify. Fails if application_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_track_installation
description: Tracks installation_status ('not_started', 'in_progress', 'installed', 'verified', 'operational'). Application must be approved. Requires session_token. Does NOT perform installation. Fails if application not approved or application_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_monitor_generation
description: Monitors solar energy generation_status ('not_generating', 'generating', 'exporting', 'idle', 'fault'). Plant must be 'operational'. Returns current output, daily/monthly generation. Requires session_token. Does NOT control plant. Generation depends on weather and system health. Fails if plant not operational.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_track_exported_energy
description: Tracks energy exported to the grid via net metering. Returns units exported, tariff rate, and expected revenue. Requires session_token. Does NOT process payments. Meter readings may be delayed. Fails if plant not operational or net metering not active.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_track_payment
description: Tracks payment_status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'processed', 'credited', 'failed') for energy export revenue. Payments depend on DISCOM processing and may be delayed. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate payments. Fails if no export records.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_report_fault
description: Reports a fault or system issue with the solar plant. Transitions generation_status to 'fault'. Requires session_token. Plant must be 'operational'. Does NOT repair. Fails if plant not installed or duplicate fault report exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_get_tariff_details
description: Returns current tariff rates for energy exported to grid. Rates may vary by state and policy. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee future rates. Fails if tariff data unavailable for farmer's region.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_calculate_revenue
description: Calculates estimated revenue based on generation data and tariff rates. Requires session_token. Estimate only — actual payment may differ due to DISCOM adjustments. Fails if no generation data.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_get_grid_status
description: Returns grid_status ('not_connected', 'connected', 'active', 'disrupted') for the solar plant connection. Requires session_token. Does NOT restore grid. Fails if plant_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_schedule_maintenance
description: Schedules maintenance for the solar plant. Requires session_token. Plant must be 'operational' or 'fault'. Does NOT perform maintenance. Fails if scheduling conflict or plant not installed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_raise_grievance
description: Raises PM-KUSUM grid grievance. Categories: 'installation_delay', 'low_generation', 'payment_delay', 'metering_issue', 'system_fault'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusumgrid_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks PM-KUSUM grid grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
